label: 主要用途
Primary uses
value: 穿行、停留、文化参观、活动

label: 服务对象
Users
value: BOTH · 社区与游客；旅游焦点
BOTH · community and visitors; tourism focus

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-12-31；Comune di Venezia全市镇，含大陆地区；不是历史岛城人口。
31 Dec 2025; municipality including the mainland, not the historic islands alone.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Piazza主体，不含Piazzetta；意大利语维基百科公布值，属二级来源。
Piazza proper, excluding Piazzetta; published Italian Wikipedia value, a secondary source.

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 2018年Volo dell’Angelo活动限额；不是当前全时段容量。
2018 Flight of the Angel event cap; not a current permanent capacity.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 未取得广场级完整年度统计；不以威尼斯全市游客量或教堂入场人数替代。
No complete square-level annual series found; city tourism and basilica admissions are excluded.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 钟楼总高
Campanile total height
scope: 大教堂官方公布的钟楼总高；基座为12 × 12m。不是两侧Procuratie的檐口高度。
Official total campanile height; the base is 12 × 12 m. This is not a Procuratie cornice height.

label: 北侧修复项目立面范围
Northern restoration project frontage
scope: Generali项目涉及43／50个外部拱券、约12,400m²总楼面；152m是项目立面范围，不是整侧建筑总长。
Generali’s project covers 43 of 50 external arches and about 12,400 m² gross floor area; 152 m is its project frontage, not a verified entire-side length.

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: Piazza、柱廊与Piazzetta形成由围合到水岸的清晰序列。
Piazza, arcades and Piazzetta form a legible sequence from enclosure to waterfront.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 以水上巴士加步行为主；不是汽车直达型广场。
Waterbus plus walking is the principal approach, not direct car access.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: 以潟湖水岸及硬质铺地为主，广场核心并非植被公园。
Lagoon frontage and paving dominate; the square core is not a planted park.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 咖啡座与商铺沿建筑边缘展开；商业座位不能等同免费公共座位。
Cafes and shops line the edges; commercial seats are not free public seating.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季日晒与湿热、降雨及异常高潮位影响使用；覆盖边缘和预警是主要应对。
Summer sun and humidity, rain and high tides affect use; covered edges and warnings provide responses.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类功能并存。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 平日以游览、步行和外摆为主；狂欢节等活动可限制入口和容量。
Ordinary days emphasise visits, walking and terraces; Carnival events can impose entry and capacity limits.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: 2018活动上限20,000人；广场级年到访量未确认。
2018 event cap: 20,000; square-level annual visitation remains unestablished.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 活动限流使用数字计数设备；潮汐监测与预警服务通行，非娱乐屏幕主导。
Digital event counting and tide warnings support management; entertainment screens are not the defining infrastructure.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 服务社区仪式与公共生活，同时是全球游客目的地；不赋虚构居民／游客比例。
Serves civic rituals and public life as well as global visitors; no resident/tourist percentage is invented.

title: 连续柱廊
Continuous arcades
text: 把建筑立面转化为有遮蔽、可穿行的公共边缘。
Turns building fronts into covered, walkable public edges.

title: 广场—水岸序列
Square–waterfront sequence
text: 从围合的Piazza经过Piazzetta到潟湖，空间有方向也有变化。
Moves from enclosed Piazza through Piazzetta to lagoon with both direction and variety.

title: 仪式与日常共用
Ritual and everyday sharing
text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.

title: Piazza San Marco
Piazza San Marco
lede: 以连续柱廊围合城市舞台，再通过Piazzetta把空间打开到潟湖。
A civic stage enclosed by arcades, opening through the Piazzetta to the lagoon.

label: 面积：Piazza主体12,600 m²（二级资料）
Area: Piazza proper 12,600 m² (secondary source)

title: 位置：步行街巷与水上交通之间
Location: between pedestrian lanes and water transport
lede: 市镇常住人口251,294人（2025年末）；数字包含大陆地区，广场位于历史岛城。
251,294 municipal residents at end-2025, including the mainland; the square lies in the historic island city.

title: 公共交通
Public transport
text: 可乘ACTV水上巴士到San Marco–Vallaresso或San Zaccaria，再步行进入广场。
ACTV waterbuses serve San Marco–Vallaresso and San Zaccaria, followed by a walk into the square.

title: 最后一段步行
The final walk
text: Piazza与水岸由步行地面连接；桥梁、潮位及临时通道会改变实际到达条件。
Pedestrian ground joins Piazza and waterfront; bridges, tides and temporary routes affect access.

title: 城市角色
Civic role
text: 既是世界级旅游焦点，也承载城市仪式与公共活动；不能把全部使用都解释成游客消费。
A major tourism focus that also hosts civic rituals and public events; use is not reducible to tourist consumption.

label: 威尼斯市政府：2025居民人口
City of Venice: 2025 residents
威尼斯市政府：Marciana无障碍到达指引
City of Venice: Marciana access routes

title: 平面演变：西端如何从教堂变成完整界面
Plan evolution: replacing a church with a continuous western edge
lede: 1689与1831两张真实平面，记录同一广场西端重建前后的差异。
Actual plans from 1689 and 1831 record the western rebuilding of the same square.

title: 1689：旧西端
1689: the earlier west end
text: Robert de Cotte的图纸早于拿破仑翼，西端仍由San Geminiano教堂参与组织。
Robert de Cotte’s drawing predates the Napoleonic Wing; San Geminiano still structures the west end.

title: 1807—1814：重建
1807–1814: rebuilding
text: 原教堂拆除，新翼延续相邻建筑的层次与开间，把西端纳入连续边界。
The church was removed and the new wing extended the layered, bay-based frontage.

title: 1831：新整体
1831: the new ensemble
text: 图版I呈现改造后的Piazza与Piazzetta；图版IX进一步对照新旧平面与立面。
Plate I records the altered Piazza and Piazzetta; Plate IX compares old and new plans with the elevation.
两张历史图保持原图方向与比例，不作为同尺度叠图；可点击放大辨认建筑边界。
Historical orientation and scale are retained; these are not a calibrated overlay. Enlarge to read the building edges.

label: 1689 · Robert de Cotte：改造前的Piazza与Piazzetta
1689 · Robert de Cotte: Piazza and Piazzetta before the western rebuilding
1831 · Quadri／Moretti 图版I：改造后的总平面
1831 · Quadri / Moretti, Plate I: plan after the western rebuilding

title: 立面演变：保留柱廊节奏，重写西端
Elevation evolution: arcade rhythm, transformed west end
lede: 新旧立面展开图与1831图版共同显示：变化集中在西端，连续柱廊维持广场的整体性。
The comparative elevations and the 1831 plate locate the transformation at the west end while arcades maintain the ensemble.

text: 上排保留San Geminiano教堂，下排改为拿破仑翼。比较入口位置、层数与开间节奏，可见宗教端景如何转为连续的城市立面。
San Geminiano appears in the upper row and the Napoleonic Wing below. Compare entrances, storeys and bays: a church front becomes a continuous civic edge.

title: 同一比例，看三种城市肌理
One scale, three urban fabrics
lede: 在同一图幅中，Piazza表现为密集城市肌理里的大块开放地面，并向水岸展开。
Within the common frame, Piazza appears as a substantial opening in dense urban fabric, extending to water.

text: 三案均为600 × 600米，北向上、横纵同尺度；矢量图按300毫米宽输出时为1:2500。网页缩放请读图形比例尺。
All three frames cover 600 × 600 m, north up with identical axis scale. Native SVG at 300 mm width is 1:2500; use the graphic bar on screens.

title: 平面：空间如何组织
Plan: how the place is organised
lede: Piazza与Piazzetta形成不同朝向、相互连续的公共地面。
Piazza and Piazzetta form connected civic surfaces with different orientations.

text: Piazza的长向空间指向大教堂；Piazzetta转向水岸。连续地面把围合与开敞两种体验串成一次步行。
The Piazza leads toward the basilica, while the Piazzetta turns to the waterfront. Continuous ground links enclosure and openness in one walk.

title: 剖面：地面、柱廊与地标
Section: ground, arcade and landmark
lede: 历史建筑图帮助理解垂直边界；地面本身不以明显坡地组织方向。
Historic drawings explain vertical edges; strong ground slopes are not the organising device.

text: 钟楼总高98.6m，基座12 × 12m；这个垂直地标的高度不能代替Procuratie柱廊的檐口高度。
The campanile is 98.6 m tall with a 12 × 12 m base; the landmark’s height cannot substitute for the Procuratie arcade cornice height.
在这里，空间的主要变化来自建筑边界与垂直地标。历史剖面保留建筑层级；它不是整个广场的最新地形测绘。
Here, architectural edges and vertical landmarks drive the spatial change. The historic section retains building levels; it is not a current terrain survey of the whole square.

label: 大教堂官方：钟楼尺寸与重建
Official basilica: campanile dimensions and reconstruction

title: 连接：抵达、穿行与停留
Connections: arrival, passage and staying
lede: 圣马可既是目的地，也是从城市街巷到水岸的通道。
San Marco is both destination and passage between city lanes and waterfront.

title: 抵达
Arrival
text: 水上交通把到达点放在广场边缘，再转为步行。
Water transport places arrival near the edge, followed by walking.

title: 穿行
Passage
text: Piazzetta把城市广场与潟湖门厅联结起来。
Piazzetta links the civic square and lagoon threshold.

title: 停留
Staying
text: 中央与柱廊边缘提供不同的开敞和遮蔽体验。
Centre and arcade edges provide different degrees of openness and cover.
从街巷进入Piazza，再转向Piazzetta与潟湖：封闭与开敞交替，使抵达本身成为清晰的空间序列。
Lanes lead into Piazza, then Piazzetta and the lagoon: enclosure and openness alternate in a legible sequence.

label: 官方到达与无障碍路线
Official access and step-free route information

title: 边界：建筑与公共地面
Edges: buildings meet civic ground
lede: 柱廊提供连续边缘，大教堂与钟楼提供强烈的定位参照。
Arcades provide a continuous edge; basilica and bell tower provide clear orientation.

text: 柱廊、首层开口和咖啡外摆共同使建筑边界成为可使用的空间；中央铺地则保留为穿行、停留与活动的共同场地。
Arcades, ground-floor openings and cafe terraces make the edge usable; the centre remains shared ground for passage, staying and events.
北侧Generali修复项目涉及43／50个外部拱券，临广场立面范围152m、总楼面约12,400m²。这是项目范围，不代表已测得整侧檐口高度或建筑总长。

Generali’s northern restoration project includes 43 of 50 external arches, 152 m of square-facing frontage and about 12,400 m² gross floor area. These describe the project, not a surveyed entire-side cornice height or length.

title: Piazzetta与水岸：总督宫原有图纸
Piazzetta and waterfront: retained Ducal Palace drawings

text: 总督宫定义Piazzetta与水岸，而不是Piazza两侧的Procuratie边界。下部双层柱廊开放、上部墙体较实，形成不同于普通街墙的公共界面。
The palace defines Piazzetta and the waterfront, rather than the two Procuratie edges. Its open lower arcades and solid upper wall create a distinct civic frontage.

label: Generali原始项目说明：范围与尺寸
Generali original project statement: extent and dimensions

title: 环境：景观、气候与科技
Environment: landscape, climate and technology
lede: 硬质地面、潟湖背景与覆盖柱廊共同塑造使用条件；天气适应的关键是遮蔽与潮位管理。
Paving, lagoon setting and covered arcades shape use; cover and tide management are the principal environmental responses.

title: 景观
Landscape
text: 潟湖是最重要的自然背景，广场内部以石材铺地为主。
The lagoon is the principal natural setting; stone paving dominates within the square.

title: 天气与气候
Weather and climate
text: 气候偏湿润，夏季热、冬季凉；市中心2001—2020降雨研究中9月、11月较湿。柱廊提供局部遮蔽，高潮位需独立预警。
Humid conditions with warm summers and cool winters; central-city 2001–2020 records show wetter September and November. Arcades offer local cover; high tides require separate warnings.

title: 科技
Technology
text: 潮汐预报和活动数字计数服务空间管理。
Tide forecasting and digital event counting support spatial management.

City of Venice: central-city rainfall, 2001–2020

title: 平日：人们怎样使用这里
Ordinary days: how people use the place
lede: 同一地面支持穿行、文化参观、自由停留和咖啡消费；免费与商业空间应分开阅读。
The same ground supports passage, cultural visits, informal stay and cafe consumption; free and commercial spaces are distinct.

text: 平日的公共性来自自由穿行与停留，也受到商业外摆和游览组织的影响。
Ordinary-day publicness includes free movement and staying, shaped also by terraces and visitor management.

label: 市政府：商业外摆占地管理
Municipality: outdoor terrace occupation

title: 这里发生过什么：历史、典礼、音乐与集会
What happened here: history, ceremony, music and assembly
lede: 按时间列出在场地内发生、或明确通过场地共同观看的事件。每项说明地点与空间意义。
A chronology of events held here, or explicitly watched here by broadcast. Each entry identifies its spatial role.

title: 公共活动：这里可以参与什么
Public activities: what people can take part in
lede: 从活动内容、参与方式和现场布置，读懂公共地面如何被不同的人使用。
Read the programme, participation and layout to see how different people use the civic ground.

title: 节假日与活动：地面的另一种状态
Holidays and events: the ground transforms
lede: 活动日改变进入方式与使用密度；潮汐积水则改变可走的路线。
Events change entry arrangements and crowding; tidal flooding changes usable routes.

title: 节日庆典：有名称、有场景的公共生活
Festivals: named celebrations, visible civic life
lede: 从舞台朝向、观众站位与通行路径，看节庆如何把同一地面变成另一种公共场景。
Stage orientation, audience positions and circulation show how festivals transform the same ground into another civic setting.

title: 数字：规模、容量与使用强度
Numbers: scale, capacity and use
lede: 人口按市镇／LGA范围；容量是特定活动或场地布置口径；年到访量单独列出。
Population uses municipal/LGA boundaries; capacity is event- or layout-specific; annual visitation is listed separately.

text: 活动容量不是全年访客量，也不是随时允许进入的人数。三案未公开同口径的平日／节假日人流序列，因此不伪造倍数关系。
Event capacity is neither annual visitation nor a constant admission allowance. Matched ordinary-day/holiday footfall series are unavailable, so no multiplier is invented.

title: 统一评价①：空间与环境
Aligned assessment 1: space and environment
lede: 以下五项在三个案例中采用完全相同的名称、顺序和判断口径。
The same five dimensions, in the same order and with the same interpretation, apply to all three cases.

title: 统一评价②：使用与公共性
Aligned assessment 2: use and publicness
lede: 区分功能、时段、规模、科技与服务对象；BOTH表示社区与游客均被服务，不代表两者人数相等。
Separate programme, timing, scale, technology and users. BOTH means both communities and visitors are served, not equal headcounts.

title: 最突出的三个特点
Three defining qualities
lede: 它最值得借鉴的是边界与空间序列，而不是孤立地复制纪念性建筑。
Its transferable strength lies in edges and spatial sequence rather than isolated monumental objects.

title: 连续柱廊
Continuous arcades
text: 把建筑立面转化为有遮蔽、可穿行的公共边缘。
Turns building fronts into covered, walkable public edges.

title: 广场—水岸序列
Square–waterfront sequence
text: 从围合的Piazza经过Piazzetta到潟湖，空间有方向也有变化。
Moves from enclosed Piazza through Piazzetta to lagoon with both direction and variety.

title: 仪式与日常共用
Ritual and everyday sharing
text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.
主要限制：旅游压力、商业占地和潮汐会改变公共空间的实际可用范围。
Principal limitation: tourism pressure, commercial occupation and tides affect usable public space.

title: 资料与证据边界
Sources and evidence limits
lede: 正文保留空间判断；完整出处、统计口径与方法集中在这里。
The main pages focus on spatial findings; complete provenance, statistical definitions and methods are collected here.

text: 保留来源年份、统计范围与空值。01的2018活动限额、03的2026赛事站立区和04的现行场租容量不可直接理解为同一时点的全广场安全上限。
Year, boundary and missing values are retained. The 2018 event cap in 01, 2026 standing area in 03 and current venue listing in 04 are not a single-date set of universal safety limits.

Google Maps is the common location map. Figure-ground uses an identical metric frame: 01/03 use Overture 2026-10-21 through TerraLab; 04 retains official Melbourne 2020 ground/podium data. Dates and footprint definitions differ; results describe form rather than rank civic quality.

text: 连接章节是基于地图、图纸与照片的形态解读，不是本站正式空间句法计算。没有用照片推算人数、建筑高度、容量或全年舒适度；没有以城市游客数或单座博物馆入场数替代广场年访客量。

Connectivity is a reading of maps, drawings and photographs, not a formal syntax computation by this site. Photos do not supply population, heights, capacity or annual comfort; city tourism and individual museum admissions do not replace square-level annual visitation.
图像保留原作者版权，逐图出处可展开查看。学术剖面作为有限图示摘录保留原始几何和比例尺，并非本站实测；图底是数据重建，非施工或测绘边界。

Creators retain image rights; per-image credits expand in place. Limited scholarly drawing excerpts retain original geometry and bars; they are not surveys by this site. GIS drawings are data reconstructions, not construction or legal survey boundaries.

title: Piazza San Marco · 一页档案
Piazza San Marco · factsheet
lede: 以连续柱廊围合城市舞台，再通过Piazzetta把空间打开到潟湖。
A civic stage enclosed by arcades, opening through the Piazzetta to the lagoon.

text: 三个特点：连续柱廊；广场—水岸序列；仪式与日常共用。
Three qualities: Continuous arcades; Square–waterfront sequence; Ritual and everyday sharing.

intro_lede: 以连续柱廊围合城市舞台，再通过Piazzetta把空间打开到潟湖。
A civic stage enclosed by arcades, opening through the Piazzetta to the lagoon.
plan_text: Piazza的长向空间指向大教堂；Piazzetta转向水岸。连续地面把围合与开敞两种体验串成一次步行。
The Piazza leads toward the basilica, while the Piazzetta turns to the waterfront. Continuous ground links enclosure and openness in one walk.

text: 在这里，空间的主要变化来自建筑边界与垂直地标。历史剖面保留建筑层级；它不是整个广场的最新地形测绘。
Here, architectural edges and vertical landmarks drive the spatial change. The historic section retains building levels; it is not a current terrain survey of the whole square.

syntax_lede: 圣马可既是目的地，也是从城市街巷到水岸的通道。
San Marco is both destination and passage between city lanes and waterfront.

label: 官方到达与无障碍路线
Official access and step-free route information

boundary_lede: 柱廊提供连续边缘，大教堂与钟楼提供强烈的定位参照。
Arcades provide a continuous edge; basilica and bell tower provide clear orientation.
boundary_text: 柱廊、首层开口和咖啡外摆共同使建筑边界成为可使用的空间；中央铺地则保留为穿行、停留与活动的共同场地。
Arcades, ground-floor openings and cafe terraces make the edge usable; the centre remains shared ground for passage, staying and events.
environment_lede: 硬质地面、潟湖背景与覆盖柱廊共同塑造使用条件；天气适应的关键是遮蔽与潮位管理。
Paving, lagoon setting and covered arcades shape use; cover and tide management are the principal environmental responses.

name: 音乐会与户外歌剧
Concerts and outdoor opera
when: 实例：2025-07-12，La Fenice《乡村骑士》音乐会版
Example: 12 Jul 2025, La Fenice’s Cavalleria rusticana in concert
access: 售票观看；不是全天自由入场的公共活动
Ticketed attendance, not unrestricted all-day access
text: 乐团、合唱与歌剧独唱把广场变成露天剧场。
Orchestra, chorus and soloists turn the square into an open-air theatre.
spatial_change: 临时舞台和成排座椅建立朝向，部分自由通行地面转为观众区。
Temporary stage and chair rows establish a viewing direction and occupy normally open ground.

name: 步行、相会与水岸停留
Walking, meeting and waterfront staying
access: 公共地面可步行停留；咖啡馆消费与建筑参观另计
Walk and stay on public ground; cafes and building admission are separate
text: 穿行Piazza，经Piazzetta走到潟湖，在柱廊与水岸选择停留位置。
Cross Piazza and Piazzetta to the lagoon, choosing places to stop along arcades and waterfront.
spatial_change: 不设统一观看方向，路径、自由停留与商业外摆共存。
No single viewing direction: routes, informal pauses and commercial terraces coexist.

name: Carnevale：开幕与装扮展演
Carnevale: opening and costumed performance
when: 已记录实例：2025年狂欢节开幕
access: 观看舞台与装扮活动；参与办法依当届主办方公告
Watch stage and costume events; participation follows that edition’s organiser
text: 表演、音乐与面具装扮把日常城市地面变成节庆聚集场所。
Performance, music and masks transform everyday civic ground into a festive gathering place.
spatial_change: 舞台、灯光、站立观众及入口管理改变广场的使用方向。
Stage, lighting, standing spectators and managed entrances change how the square is used.

name: Festa delle Marie：狂欢节中的城市典礼
Festa delle Marie: a civic ceremony within Carnival
access: 观看公开亮相；候选人选拔不是任意到场报名
Watch the public presentation; candidate selection is a separate process
text: 年度Maria与同伴在圣马可广场向公众亮相，连接城市传统与当代庆典。
The annual Maria and companions appear before the public, connecting civic tradition and contemporary celebration.
spatial_change: 仪式在舞台集中，观众在建筑界面前聚集；与开幕同属狂欢节。
Ceremony focuses on a stage, with spectators gathering before the facades; this is part of Carnival.

name: San Geminiano拆除与拿破仑翼重建
San Geminiano removed; the Napoleonic Wing built
text: 西端从教堂端景转为延续两侧柱廊的建筑界面，改变今日广场的围合方式。
A church frontage became an edge continuing the arcades, changing the square’s enclosure.

name: 圣马可钟楼倒塌
Collapse of St Mark’s Campanile
text: 标志性塔楼倒塌，广场失去最重要的垂直地标；此后的重建关系到城市共同记忆。
The collapse removed the square’s principal vertical landmark; its reconstruction became a question of civic memory.

name: 重建钟楼揭幕典礼
Inauguration of the rebuilt campanile
text: 新钟楼在圣马可节举行揭幕，延续“原样原址”的城市形象。
The rebuilt tower was inaugurated on St Mark’s Day, restoring its familiar form and location.

name: 特大潮水事件
Exceptional high tide
text: 市政府潮位记录为194cm；这是城市潮位基准读数，不是广场各处水深。
The municipal record is 194 cm: a city tide-datum reading, not water depth at every point in the square.

name: 2025狂欢节在广场开幕
2025 Carnival opening in the square
text: 开幕表演、灯光与公众聚集把广场西端改成节庆舞台。
Opening performances, lighting and the public gathering transformed the west end into a festive stage.

name: La Fenice《乡村骑士》音乐会版
La Fenice’s Cavalleria rusticana in concert
text: 乐团、合唱与独唱共同使用临时舞台；售票座席改变普通日的自由停留。
Orchestra, chorus and soloists used a temporary stage; ticketed seating changed ordinary patterns of informal staying.
